description: This file defines a Redis-backed chat memory component for a conversational AI system, including class implementation, initialization, and Redis client management.

classes.name: RedisBackedChatMemory_Memory
classes.description: Implements a memory node that stores chat history in Redis, supporting message retrieval, addition, and clearing.

classes.name: BufferMemoryExtended
classes.description: Extends FlowiseMemory to manage Redis connection and chat message operations with session management.

methods.name: initializeRedis
methods.description: Initializes Redis-based memory with configuration and credentials.

methods.name: withRedisClient
methods.description: Manages Redis client connection, ensuring proper cleanup after operations.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Retrieves chat messages from Redis, optionally with message preprocessing.

methods.name: addChatMessages
methods.description: Adds new chat messages to Redis, handling user and AI message types.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Clears chat history from Redis for a given session.
